sar.reason: Policy threshold triggered mandatory SAR filing.
sar.narrative: The SAR concerns case HHG-004 involving a customer whose identity status is verified. The trigger is transaction TXN-004 which received a risk score of 0.85. The transaction was processed in the system at the time it was flagged. The analysis identified a single device relationship linking the customer to prior activity. No connected cards were observed for this account. A prior closed case HIST-991 was found with a fraud verdict for a card‑not‑present pattern and a shared device profile, establishing relevance. The combination of a high risk score, shared device profile, and prior fraud pattern makes the activity suspicious.

stop_reason: Policy thresholds met or maximum evidence gathered.
